## revertFaqRevision

Revert Faq Revision. `POST /faq-revisions/{revision_id}/revert`

Undo one revision, restoring the entry's previous question/answer/status.

Returns the NEW revision row that records the revert — a revert is itself a change, never a silent rewrite of history.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbCorrections()->revertFaqRevision(revisionId: 'revision_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$revisionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `FaqEntryRevision`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Corrections/revert_faq_revision_api_v1_faq_revisions__revision_id__revert_post)

## create

Create Kb Correction. `POST /kb-corrections`

Report something in the knowledge base as wrong.

Reporting is deliberately an everyday agent permission — the person who notices the mistake is the one on the conversation. Deciding what the KB says still needs knowledge_base:manage.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbCorrections()->create(whatIsWrong: 'what_is_wrong');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$whatIsWrong` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$why` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$correctAnswer` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$aiAnswerEventId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$conversationId` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$faqItemIds` | `list<string>\|null` | no | Entries the reporter believes are wrong |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KbCorrection`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Corrections/create_kb_correction_api_v1_kb_corrections_post)

## approve

Approve Kb Correction. `POST /kb-corrections/{correction_id}/approve`

Apply a correction's proposed changes to the knowledge base.

Every applied change writes a faq_entry_revisions row, which is what makes this reversible in one click.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbCorrections()->approve(correctionId: 'correction_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`, `automation:update`

|---|---|---|---|
| `$correctionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KbCorrection`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Corrections/approve_kb_correction_api_v1_kb_corrections__correction_id__approve_post)

## reject

Reject Kb Correction. `POST /kb-corrections/{correction_id}/reject`

Decline a proposed correction. Nothing touches the knowledge base.

A policy correction routed to an open agent skill suggestion has its rule removed from that suggestion; with no rule left the suggestion is dismissed. The answer rating itself is kept.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbCorrections()->reject(correctionId: 'correction_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$correctionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$body` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | The request body |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KbCorrection`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Corrections/reject_kb_correction_api_v1_kb_corrections__correction_id__reject_post)

## retryAnalysis

Retry Kb Correction Analysis. `POST /kb-corrections/{correction_id}/retry-analysis`

Re-run the AI analysis of a correction that failed or stalled.

Allowed for failed corrections and for open/analyzing ones that have not moved for the stale window (a lost job). Anything else → 409 not_retryable. The row goes back to open and the analysis job is re-published; poll GET /kb-corrections/{id}.

```php
$result = $sendseven->kbCorrections()->retryAnalysis(correctionId: 'correction_id');
```

- Scopes: `knowledge_base:manage`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$correctionId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `KbCorrection`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/KB%20Corrections/retry_kb_correction_analysis_api_v1_kb_corrections__correction_id__retry_analysis_post)
